g.text: ❯ add the context bar to every agent row
● The bar rides on pane metadata — herdr drops a row whose
tokens are all unreported, so it shows up only for live
sessions and disappears when one ends.
● That is the popup: ctrl+b u — one section per agent, the
5h window over the week, same bars, same colors.
one bar per agent — that session's context window
5h and weekly, every agent, one keypress
